entries.text: Amy Hood is the executive vice president and chief financial officer at Microsoft and is responsible for leading the company’s worldwide finance organization, including accounting and reporting, acquisitions, business development and ventures, financial planning and analysis, global real estate, internal audit, investor relations, tax planning and treasury.

Hood joined Microsoft in 2002 and became EVP and CFO in 2013. Through her tenure with the company, she has advanced global momentum in cloud and helped Microsoft and its customers drive growth through technological shifts, including the era of AI. She is deeply involved in the company’s operations, as well as the strategy development and overall execution of the company’s successful acquisitions of Activision Blizzard, LinkedIn and GitHub. She has been a strategic partner to Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, propelling long-term financial growth, championing culture and driving corporate initiatives that have bolstered the company’s broader ecosystem.
Hood earned a bachelor’s degree in economics from Duke University and a master’s degree in business administration from Harvard University.

Do not invent an organization that is absent from the entries.

- role: an explicit occupational, officer, founder, ownership or board/trustee relationship. Classify role_kind as executive, board_director, controlling_owner, employee, founder, owner or unknown. binding is direct for explicitly stated endpoints, coreference for a justified pronoun/short-name reference, ambiguous when multiple antecedents remain possible, or unresolved when an endpoint cannot be bound. Keep all plausible alternatives for ambiguous binding. Direct/coreference allow at most one subject and one organization per interpretation; split distinct roles/organizations. A role with no organization anchor must remain unresolved.

status describes the source statement: asserted, denied, hypothetical, or unclear. An asserted statement is not verified truth. Preserve negative and conditional wording; never turn an instruction into an asserted role. Later correction does not rewrite an earlier statement's status.

Use context_links to preserve contextual meaning: retracts points from a correction interpretation to the specific role interpretation it withdraws; contradicts connects incompatible role statements about the same subject, organization and overlapping time. Do not mark a past and present role as contradictory merely because titles differ. Unrelated roles stay separate. Do not discard an original assertion when adding its correction. Unsupported correction chains must stay explicit as unknown/unclear interpretations, not invented transitive links.

Cover the role, binding and correction evidence in the supplied excerpts. Do not manufacture relationships for every noun or incidental event. There are at most 64 selections, 32 interpretations and 32 context links. Do not emit URLs, source hashes, provenance origin, approval flags, donor matches, confidence scores, or financial attribution; the caller owns those boundaries.
